hooks.command: /bin/sh -lc 'script=session_start.py; root="$PWD"; while [ "$root" != "/" ]; do if [ -f "$root/.codex/hooks/$script" ]; then exec /usr/bin/env python3 "$root/.codex/hooks/$script"; fi; if [ -f "$root/ai_cli_session/.codex/hooks/$script" ]; then exec /usr/bin/env python3 "$root/ai_cli_session/.codex/hooks/$script"; fi; root=$(dirname "$root"); done; gitroot=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); for cand in "$gitroot/ai_cli_session"; do if [ -f "$cand/.codex/hooks/$script" ]; then exec /usr/bin/env python3 "$cand/.codex/hooks/$script"; fi; done; exit 0'
